verdict.rationale: Docs confirm predefined/custom vesting schedules can be created and reused for grants, and the platform provides ASC 718 reporting that organizes vesting schedules and grant types — implying vested/unvested tracking. However, there is no explicit evidence of milestone-based vesting, acceleration-on-exit triggers, or automatic real-time vested-vs-unvested calculation logic being described. Missing for 10: explicit support for milestone/performance-based vesting, acceleration-on-exit clauses, and detailed automatic vested/unvested tracking mechanics.
